description: Check a vibe-coded JS/TS project's production readiness. Returns a 0-100 score and findings across security, reliability, performance, and AI quality, most severe first. Every critical finding is always included; use minSeverity, categories, and maxFindings to narrow or widen the rest.

categories.description: Only list findings in these categories (default: all)

maxFindings.description: Maximum number of findings to list (default: 30). Critical findings are always listed, even past this limit.

minSeverity.description: Only list findings at this severity or higher (default: info, i.e. all)

path.description: Absolute path to the project directory to scan; it must be inside the directory the server runs in

name: scan

matched.description: Findings that pass the minSeverity and categories filters

omitted.description: Matching findings left out because of maxFindings

summary.description: Counts of all findings, before minSeverity and categories are applied

version.description: prodlint version that ran the scan

title: Scan a project for production readiness
